name: Admin Diagnostic List — Load Error & Retry
description: When GET /api/diagnostics/ fails, the list page shows a dedicated error state (data-testid=diagnostics-error-state) with the normalized Spanish error message and a 'Reintentar' button that re-fires the fetch; an error notification is also raised via usePanelNotify. Distinct from the empty state. Covered by e2e/admin/admin-diagnostic-list-error-retry.spec.js.
